code.r:
result = flights %>%
  filter(origin == "JFK", dep_delay > 60) %>%
  mutate(gain = dep_delay - arr_delay) %>%
  select(carrier, dep_delay, gain) %>%
  arrange(desc(dep_delay)) %>%
  head(10)

result %>%
  summarize(rows_out = n(), cols_out = ncol(result))
code.sql:
SELECT carrier, dep_delay, dep_delay - arr_delay AS gain
FROM flights
WHERE origin = 'JFK'
  AND dep_delay > 60
ORDER BY dep_delay DESC
LIMIT 10;
